items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I have seen you play piano on Burbank Street. I forget who was in the band. Myrtle Jones was singing. ... That's right. That's right. The boy didn't know her number and he couldn't play her music so I had to you know fill in.

ctx.x: Well I know the instrument. I'll sit down sometimes and make a few chords but hardly I don't worry with it too much because I don't have it at home. You see if I had one at home probably you know what I mean. I would play at nine then on the job I'd make a few chords.
I have seen you play piano on Burbank Street. I forget who was in the band. Myrtle Jones was singing.
That's right. That's right. The boy didn't know her number and he couldn't play her music so I had to you know fill in.
